Many ghostly enemies appear in the Netherworld.
While they are in their incorporeal form,
none of your attacks will hit them.

You can materialize them by approaching a phantom's
candlelight or by using the magic potion "Shine."

-Score Rank and Rewards-

Once you defeat all the enemies, your performance will be
scored on a variety of factors such as your max chain attack,
damage received, the length of the battle, and so on.

Based on this score, you will earn a rank between S and D.
Aim for higher ranks since they award more gold.
(Your current rank will be displayed at the
bottom-right of the screen during battle.)

-Knockouts-
You will be sent back to the previous stage if
your HP ever reaches zero in a battle stage.
Should you hit a roadblock, reevaluate your level,
possessions, and acquired skills.

-Item Box-

You now have access to the item box.
You can use it by checking the box directly
or by talking to a merchant.

The box can hold up to 128 items, and you can take out
whatever you stored from a box in another area.

-Butterflies-

A butterfly has appeared.
You can absorb Phozons (##(PHOZON_ABSORB))
when you are nearby.

-Wild Rosemiles-

A stage will often have "rosemiles," which
produce Phozons in response to seeds.

They release Phozons when a seed is planted
nearby, so give it a try next time.

-Guard Breaks-

Sliding (@#(34)+##(ATTACK)) is useful against enemies
who have their guard up.

-Psypher Points (PP)-

You acquired a Psypher skill that consumes PP.
PP will accumulate by absorbing Phozons.

-POW-

You acquired a Psypher skill that consumes POW.
POW will automatically accumulate over time.

You now have access to the Pooka village.
Use the blue warp point on the veranda to get there.

-Restaurants-

You can eat a variety of dishes at the village's restaurants.
Their menus expand as you advance the story.

While the Touring Restaurant requires you to provide
ingredients, these places require currency such as an
"Ariel Coin," which you gather throughout your journey.
(Such coins are only used here, so use them freely.)

-Armageddon-

In the Armageddon, you will play
from each character's final save data.
You can prepare for the Armageddon by
rereading each of their respective books.

-Shared Item Box-

The item box is now shared among all
characters. You can switch to different boxes
by pressing @#(2) in the Item Box screen.

-EXP Points-

EXP points, which are necessary for leveling up,
can be acquired by eating fruits and dishes
or by defeating powerful enemies.

-Stage Information-
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                In the information displayed for the next stage,
the ★ represents the difficulty while the level                                                                                                                                                                                                          represents the enemy's strength.

You can acquire a large amount of EXP points by
defeating even more powerful enemies. At times,
it may be essential to gather items and challenge
extremely powerful foes to raise character levels.

It is useful when you want to fight against

There, you can eat a variety of meals using the
coins you gathered in your journey.
